resources.string: Neo Launcher shows an icon you set for an app with long-press, Customize, over any icon pack, and Neo 0.9.3 cannot remove it or say which apps have one. After each Apply, Iconoclast opens Neo\'s icon screen for every app the pack has an icon for, and this taps the Iconoclast Pack icon there. It reads only Neo\'s windows, only while Iconoclast is doing this, and shows nothing.
